[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Tranter''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Stealth" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' establishes that the events of ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' take place in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Tranter participated in a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|battle]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], serving aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Pioneer]]''. Following the battle, Tranter departed the ''Pioneer'', bound for the world of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Stealth" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tranter's voice is heard over [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] in the [[2010]] novel, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''.<ref name="Stealth" />
